question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

drafts.summary: Your chart supports a career built on intelligence, communication and standing, because the Sun and Mercury sit together in the career house and form Budhaditya yoga and a kendra-trikona raja yoga [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. The house, lord, karaka, varga and panchanga votes for career all come out in favour, helped by an exalted Venus and by Mars in its own sign [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka] [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga]. Mars also forms Ruchaka yoga, a combination for drive and leadership, though in a weakened form [rule:yoga.ruchaka].

areas.name: career

claims.text: The Sun and Mercury are conjoined in the 10th house from the lagna, forming Budhaditya yoga, slightly reduced because Mercury is in a weak avastha (bala or mrita) [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/18/1].

The Sun, lord of the 4th, conjoins Mercury, lord of the 2nd and 5th, in the 10th house from the lagna, forming a kendra-trikona raja yoga [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12].

Mars forms Ruchaka yoga from the lagna, placed in the 7th, and from the Sun, placed in the 10th, but in both cases it is weakened by Saturn's aspect, an unfavourable tara from the Moon and Mars standing in a marana karaka sthana [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2].

The house vote is for career: the 10th from the lagna, Aquarius, is the weakest house, but the 2nd, 6th and 11th from the lagna are strong, the 11th from the Moon (Leo) and the 11th from the Sun (Sagittarius) are strong, and the 10th from the Moon (Cancer) is about average [vote:career.house].

The lord vote is for career: the 10th lord Saturn sits in the lagna in a friend's sign with below-par strength, while the 6th lord Venus is exalted in the 11th, the 2nd lord Mercury is in the 10th, the 11th lord Jupiter is in the lagna in an enemy sign, and Mars, lord of the 10th from the Sun, is in its own sign in the 7th [vote:career.lord].
The karaka vote is for career: the Sun and Mercury occupy the 10th house, Venus is exalted in the 11th, and Saturn sits in the lagna in a friend's sign with below-par strength [vote:career.karaka].

The varga vote in the D10 is for career: Mars in Capricorn scores best, Saturn in Capricorn scores well, the Sun, Jupiter and Venus score modestly, and the Moon and Mercury are neutral [vote:career.varga].

The panchanga vote is for career: Mars, lord of the tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th from the lagna and the 10th from the Sun, and the Moon, lord of the weekday, rules the 10th from the Moon [vote:career.panchanga].

areas.paragraph: Your work life is marked by the Sun and Mercury sitting together in the part of the chart that stands for career, which forms Budhaditya yoga, a combination for a sharp mind and clear communication [rule:yoga.budhaditya]. The same pairing links the planets that rule home and learning, forming a raja yoga, a combination for authority and reputation [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. Mars adds Ruchaka yoga, a combination for drive and courage, though here it is toned down by other influences [rule:yoga.ruchaka]. The house vote, lord vote and karaka vote all lean in your favour, helped by a very strong Venus in the house of gains, even though the career house itself is not strong on its own [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka]. The varga vote, which looks at the career-specific chart, and the panchanga vote, based on the birth day's lunar details, also support the area, with Mars especially well placed [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga].

areas.name: marriage

claims.text: The house vote is for marriage: the 7th from the lagna, Scorpio, is about average, while the 2nd, 8th and 11th from the lagna are strong and the 7th from the Sun (Leo) is strong, though the 7th from the Moon (Aries) is somewhat weak [vote:marriage.house].

The lord vote is for marriage: the 7th lord Mars sits in its own sign in the 7th, the lagna lord Venus is exalted in the 11th, and the 2nd lord Mercury is in the 10th, while Jupiter, lord of the 8th and 11th, is in the lagna in an enemy sign [vote:marriage.lord].
The karaka vote is for marriage: Venus is exalted in the 11th, Jupiter is in the lagna in an enemy sign, and Mercury is in the 10th in a neutral sign [vote:marriage.karaka].
The varga vote in the D9 is for marriage: Saturn in Capricorn scores best, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus score modestly, and the Sun in Gemini is neutral [vote:marriage.varga].

The arudha vote is against marriage: the upapada in Gemini, the 2nd house, holds Rahu with no benefic, and the second upapada in Cancer and the A7 in Leo have no occupants or benefics [vote:marriage.arudha].

The KP vote is for marriage: the 7th cusp lies in Saturn's star with Mercury as sub-lord, and at the star-lord level Mars, occupying and owning the 7th, signifies the 7th and 12th and meets the matter house 7, deciding for, while Mercury itself signifies the 2nd, 5th and 10th and so touches both a matter and a denial house [vote:marriage.kp].
The panchanga vote is for marriage: Mars, lord of the tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th from the lagna and the 2nd and 7th from the Moon [vote:marriage.panchanga].

areas.paragraph: The house vote and the lord vote lean in favour of partnership, with Mars, the ruler of the partnership house, sitting strongly in its own sign there and an exalted, very strong Venus [vote:marriage.house] [vote:marriage.lord]. The karaka vote, which looks at the natural significators of marriage, and the varga vote, based on the marriage-specific chart, also come out in favour [vote:marriage.karaka] [vote:marriage.varga]. The KP vote, a method that reads the fine divisions of house cusps, favours the area through Mars, and the panchanga vote, based on the birth day's lunar details, agrees [vote:marriage.kp] [vote:marriage.panchanga]. One dissenting voice is the arudha vote, which looks at how the relationship appears outwardly, because the key point there holds the shadow planet Rahu and no helpful planet [vote:marriage.arudha].
